text: Somebody never pay wetin dem owe. Make we settle am before e turn fight.
Transformer don blow! No light for compound o.
UP NEPA! Light don come back.
Light don go again. Gen or darkness?
Transformer repair bill don open. Everybody pay your share before deadline — ask who call am for amount.
We don gather repair money! Light dey come back. Thank you my people.
Levy fail. Off-mic people full compound. Darkness continue.
Tank don empty o. Somebody go fetch water before night — no story.
Morning o! Musa don sweep corridor finish. Who need anything from market today?
